01 / Core Capabilities

Runtime visibility without the runtime tax.

Pinpoint connects runtime signals directly to the source lines responsible for them.

01 Detect

N+1 and query anomalies

Find repeated relationship queries before they become production bottlenecks. Uses Laravel's native lazy-loading signals, with SQL fingerprinting as a fallback.

Eloquent signal SQL fingerprint
Query pattern 14× Duplicate
Order → items
SELECT * FROM `items` WHERE `order_id` = ?
02 Measure

Route latency & percentile rollups

Understand request performance without heavy tracing on the request path. Percentile rollups compute in the background, never inline.

03 / CI Regression Gate

Fail the merge before an N+1 reaches production.

Run Pinpoint as a lightweight gate in GitHub Actions or your CI pipeline. Automatically exit with code 1 when lazy-loaded queries are detected.

GitHub Actions • Terminal
Exit 1 • Check Blocked
$ php artisan pinpoint:check --fail-on-n1
✗ FAIL api.orders.index
1x N+1 · Order::items()
Trigger: app/Http/Controllers/OrderController.php:34
Process completed with exit code 1. 0.14s total

Where Pinpoint differs

Built around the Laravel runtime.

Pinpoint is for developers who want actionable runtime diagnostics without a heavyweight observability stack.

Swipe to compare →
Pinpoint Telescope Pulse APM
Primary focus Route & N+1 latency General debug assistant Server health & queues Distributed APM profiling
N+1 query precision Exact relation & model Manual query count logs Aggregate slow query list Call tree & span waterfall
Source line traceback Exact file and line Backtrace in web modal — Stack trace on slow span
Execution environment CLI and native IDE Local web dashboard Central web dashboard Cloud SaaS interface
Telemetry residency Local machine only In-app database Redis / app database External third-party cloud
Request overhead 0.29ms mean (deferred) High (inline event recording) Low (sampled) Medium–High (agent tracing)

Capabilities cross-referenced against current stable releases. Verify on your own stack — that's the point.

04 / Documentation

Get started in minutes.

Install, migrate, run your app. Then one command tells you what's slow.

01

Install as a dev dependency

$ composer require asimali/pinpoint --dev
02

Publish & run migrations

$ php artisan vendor:publish --tag="pinpoint-migrations" && php artisan migrate
03

Generate your first latency report

$ php artisan pinpoint:report

What Pinpoint adds to each request

Recording runs after your response is sent, not during it. A 1,420 ms route measures 1,420.29 ms with Pinpoint on — a difference users never feel.

Pinpoint v1.0.0 Stable

Pinpoint finds slow routes and N+1 queries in your Laravel app with one terminal command, pointing directly to the exact file and line to fix. Zero browser context-switching, zero external telemetry.
